name: sync-drive
description: Compare an everyday Primary drive against its Replica, and bring the Replica up to date on approval.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build:app && npm run build:native
scripts.build:app: esbuild src/app/renderer/main.tsx --bundle --format=esm --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --outfile=dist/app/renderer/main.js && esbuild src/app/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/app/preload.cjs && cp src/app/renderer/index.html src/app/renderer/styles.css dist/app/renderer/
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron --test --test-concurrency=1 "test/**/*.test.ts"
